# TraininGenie

> TraininGenie (also written Training Genie or Trainingenie) is a corporate training and learning and development company based in Bengaluru, India. It provides need-based, customized training for organizations across technology, leadership and soft skills, management systems (ITIL, PRINCE2, Agile, COBIT, DevOps), and ISO standards, governance, risk and compliance. The official website is https://www.trainingenie.com/.

## Key facts

- Name: TraininGenie (one word, capital G). Common search variants: Training Genie, Trainingenie, TrainingGenie.
- Type: Corporate training and learning and development (L&D) partner.
- Founder: Mousumi Chakraborty, Founder Director.
- Based in: Bengaluru, India. Kolkata is also an associated location. Serves organizations across India.
- Official website: https://www.trainingenie.com/
- Email: s.mousumi@gmail.com
- Phone: +91 70226 12620, +91 88846 26200
- Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainingenie/
- Approach: requirements-driven training that starts from the client problem and works backward from the desired outcome. Learning philosophy: Knowledge. Hands-On. Fun.
- Values (PRIDE): Passion, Respect, Innovation, Determination, Enthusiasm.

## Training areas

- Technology training (cloud, Azure, AI and machine learning, data, ReactJS, microservices, cybersecurity, networking, ERP): https://www.trainingenie.com/technology-training
- Leadership and soft skills training (leadership, communication, presentation skills, time management, conflict management, Design Thinking, campus to corporate): https://www.trainingenie.com/leadership-soft-skills-training
- Management systems and frameworks (ITIL, PRINCE2, PRINCE2 Agile, COBIT, DevOps, change management): https://www.trainingenie.com/itil-prince2-agile-training
- ISO, standards and GRC training (ISO 9001, ISO 20000, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 31000, GDPR, enterprise risk): https://www.trainingenie.com/iso-standards-training
- Training methodology: https://www.trainingenie.com/training-methodology
